## Type of change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature (e.g. a provider)
- [ ] Security hardening
- [ ] Docs / tooling
- [ ] Breaking change

## Checklist

- [ ] `go build ./...` passes
- [ ] `go test ./... -race` passes
- [ ] `gofmt -l .` is clean and `go vet ./...` passes
- [ ] Added or updated tests for the change
- [ ] Updated docs (README / SECURITY.md / CHANGELOG.md) if behavior changed
